home.description: FlowQueue digitizes turn management in public institutions. Get your number from your phone and view your position in real time.

functionalities.label: Features
functionalities.title: Features designed to reduce queues and organize service
functionalities.description: FlowQueue brings together the core tools citizens, operators and supervisors need to work with clear and updated information.
functionalities.highlightTitle: Control the queue from ticket request to final report
functionalities.highlightDescription: The platform connects the citizen’s virtual ticket with the operator panel and supervisor metrics, avoiding isolated processes and reducing manual work.

items.title: Virtual ticket
items.desc: Allows citizens to get a ticket from their phone before arriving at the branch.

items.title: Real-time queue
items.desc: Shows the citizen’s position, ticket status and estimated waiting time.

items.title: Notifications
items.desc: Sends alerts when the turn is coming soon, helping users arrive at the right moment.

items.title: Operator panel
items.desc: Makes it easier to call tickets, mark statuses and prioritize special cases from a simple interface.

items.title: Branch analytics
items.desc: Allows teams to review waiting times, peak hours and performance by counter or service.

items.title: Multi-branch management
items.desc: Centralizes the administration of multiple branches, services and operators in one platform.

profiles.label: User profiles
profiles.title: One platform for citizens, operators and supervisors
profiles.description: FlowQueue organizes the experience of each actor involved in service delivery, from ticket request to branch-level performance analysis.

pricing.label: Plans
pricing.title: Choose the right plan for your institution
pricing.description: FlowQueue adapts to small branches, high-demand institutions and organizations that need advanced virtual queue management.

plans.name: Basic
plans.description: For small branches that need to organize service and reduce disorder in physical queues.

plans.name: Institutional
plans.description: For public entities with higher citizen flow and branch-level service control needs.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.description: For institutions that require integrations, advanced analytics and personalized support.

pricing.note: Prices are referential for the validation stage. FlowQueue can adapt to the real needs of each public institution or pilot branch.

team.label: About us
team.title: We build a more organized way to serve citizens
team.title2: Building tools that quicken and simplify day to day tasks
team.description: FlowQueue was created as an academic and technological proposal to reduce disorder in physical queues at public institutions, improving citizen experience and administrative staff management.
team.storyTitle: A solution based on an everyday problem
team.storyDescription: The project started by identifying that many people lose time in queues without clear information about their turn. FlowQueue proposes a web platform to manage virtual tickets, monitor queues and support branch-level decision-making.
team.missionDescription: Help public institutions organize their service processes through a simple, accessible and data-oriented solution.
team.visionDescription: Turn FlowQueue into a scalable solution for high-demand branches, reducing waiting times and improving citizen trust.
team.membersDescription: We are a student team focused on designing a useful, clear and applicable solution for real citizen service scenarios.

footer.description: FlowQueue is a web platform for managing virtual queues, improving citizen service and supporting public institutions with real-time metrics.
footer.note: Academic project developed to validate a virtual queue management solution.

problem.label: Problem
problem.title: Physical queues still affect citizen service
problem.description: Many public institutions still manage service processes manually, causing long waiting times, disorganized counters and limited information for citizens.

items.title: Uncertain waiting
items.description: Citizens do not know how long they must wait or when they should approach the branch.

items.title: Manual management
items.description: Administrative staff often control turns manually, increasing mistakes, delays and operational disorder.

items.title: Lack of data
items.description: Supervisors do not have clear metrics to identify peak hours or improve resource distribution.

howItWorks.label: How it works
howItWorks.title: A simple process for citizens and institutions
howItWorks.description: FlowQueue organizes service from the moment a citizen requests a ticket until the institution measures branch performance.

steps.title: Search for an institution
steps.description: The citizen selects the institution, branch and service they need.

steps.title: Generate a virtual ticket
steps.description: They receive a turn code from their phone without having to wait physically from the beginning.

steps.title: Monitor the queue
steps.description: They view their position, ticket status and estimated waiting time in real time.

steps.title: Manage service flow
steps.description: The operator calls tickets and the supervisor reviews metrics to improve the service flow.
